outlook.statement: Company is taking effective steps to improve the performance of the Company through growth in revenue, managing cost, strategic marketing, increasing brand awareness and brand equity through advertisement campaign etc.

Urja Global Limited remains optimistic about its growth prospects, supported by India's increasing focus on renewable energy, electric mobility, energy storage solutions, and sustainable development. Government initiatives promoting solar power adoption, clean transportation, domestic manufacturing, and energy security continue to create a favorable environment.

The Company has also strengthened its presence in the lithium-ion battery and electric mobility segments, aligning its business strategy with the increasing demand for energy storage systems and electric vehicles. Growing adoption of electric two-wheelers, e-rickshaws, and battery-based energy solutions presents significant opportunities for business expansion in the coming years.
Going forward, the Company will continue to focus on expanding its product portfolio, strengthening market reach, improving operational efficiencies, and enhancing customer value.

The Company continues to strengthen its risk management practices and internal control systems to effectively address emerging risks while pursuing sustainable growth opportunities in the renewable energy and electric mobility sectors.
Government initiatives promoting renewable energy deployment, domestic manufacturing, and sustainable transportation continue to provide long-term growth opportunities for the Company.

In order to provide the Company with adequate flexibility to raise capital for meeting its future growth plans, business expansion, and other general corporate purposes, the Board of Directors proposes to seek the approval of the members to raise funds by way of issuance of equity shares and/or other eligible securities, in one or more tranches, for an aggregate amount not exceeding USD 500 Million, through such permissible modes as may be approved by the Board, including public issue, preferential issue, qualified institutions placement, private placement or any other mode permitted under applicable laws.
